# Ready Pixel Go

> Ready Pixel Go is an interactive LED-arcade floor in central Ronneby, Blekinge, in southern Sweden. Groups of 1-6 people book private 30-minute sessions online, from 199 SEK to 329 SEK per person. The venue is about 25 minutes by car from Karlskrona and Karlshamn. Our former Solna (Stockholm) venue closed permanently in September 2026.

## About

Ready Pixel Go is an interactive LED-arcade floor: the floor is the game board and your whole body is the controller. Players step on colored pixels to score points, dodge obstacles, and compete in various game modes. Good for families, friend groups, birthday parties (barnkalas) and team-building in Blekinge and the rest of southern Sweden.

- **Address**: Karlskronagatan 32, 372 30 Ronneby, Sweden
- **Phone**: +46 76-614 77 30
- **Email**: info@readypixelgo.se
- **Website**: https://readypixelgo.se/ronneby/
- **Region served**: Ronneby, Karlskrona, Karlshamn, Sölvesborg, Olofström and the rest of Blekinge, as well as Skåne (Kristianstad), Kronoberg (Växjö) and Kalmar

## How It Works

- Players step on blue pixels to score points. Green pixels are safe zones.
- Avoid red pixels at all costs — they cost you points!
- Multiple game categories available: play 1v1 or cooperate as a team for the highest score.
- Great for teambuilding, friend groups, or family outings.

## Pricing

- **Price**: 199 SEK to 329 SEK per person, depending on group size (1-6 people) and age (adult or under 18). The more you are, the cheaper it gets.
- **Maximum group size**: 6 people per session
- **Session length**: 30 minutes, including the walkthrough of the instructions

## Opening Hours

- **Every day**: 11:00–20:00 (last session starts 20:00)

## Booking

- Book online at: https://readypixelgo.se/ronneby/
- Sessions can be booked up to 12 hours before they start
- Arrive 10 minutes early to change
- Wear comfortable sports clothing and indoor shoes

## How to Find Us

- **Address**: Karlskronagatan 32, 372 30 Ronneby
- **Getting there**: Central Ronneby, close to buses and parking. About 25 minutes by car from Karlskrona and Karlshamn.
- [Google Maps](https://maps.google.com/?q=Karlskronagatan+32+Ronneby)

## FAQ

- **What is Ready Pixel Go?** An interactive LED-arcade floor entertainment venue in Ronneby, Blekinge.
- **Where is it?** Karlskronagatan 32, central Ronneby, about 25 minutes by car from Karlskrona and Karlshamn.
- **How much does it cost?** Between 199 SEK and 329 SEK per person, depending on group size (1-6 people) and age. The more you are, the cheaper it gets!
- **How many people per session?** Up to 6 people.
- **How long is a session?** 30 minutes, including the instructions.
- **Do I need to change clothes?** Wear comfortable sports clothing and indoor shoes.
- **What ages are allowed?** All ages are welcome.
- **Is the Solna venue still open?** No. The Solna (Stockholm) venue closed permanently in September 2026. Ronneby is our only venue.
